# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired and plump child who is neat, immaculate, and genteel in her presentation. She possesses long, sleek curls, gentle hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a mouth set in a decorous expression. She often wears a crisp, starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

## Personality

Lucy is remarkably well-behaved, calm, and predictable, demonstrating extreme decorum and rigidity for her age. She is extremely tidy, systematic, hard-working, and dependable, carrying out all her small responsibilities without needing to be reminded. Unemotional and submissive, she approaches tasks and lessons like a small automaton. While modest and quiet in formal company, she remains unfazed even during frightening situations.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c10 P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033)_

## History

Lucy grew up with her twin brother, Robin, and her mother, Mary, who was in persistent ill health following the death of their father. After her mother's passing, Thirza Abernethy brought Lucy and Robin to live at Grey Shutters. Lucy adapted quickly to her new life, regularly assisting Thirza and Nell with household chores and tending to a small garden plot with meticulous care. During a gathering of the Aid Society at Grey Shutters, she sat politely in the parlor in her best dress. She was also granted a long-promised boat trip into town with Thirza. Following the death of her father, Richard Farrow, a trust was settled that allowed Lucy and her brother to remain at Grey Shutters permanently. During a severe severe hailstorm that frightened the rest of the household, Lucy remained remarkably still and composed while holding hands with Nell.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011), [v2 c20 P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025)_
